title: Graph revision reducer decomposition
description: Objective: reduce the graph-revision reducer below the permanent file-size cap by extracting result/error/state-clone responsibility. Deliverable: focused packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts plus a <=250-line graph-revision-reducer.ts that preserves reduceGraphRevision, command/transition exports, rejection precedence, stable codes, event/version ordering, and frozen results. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: contract changes, new transitions, graph mutation rules, planning-run changes, or test rewrites. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.ts and packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: reduceGraphRevision and GRAPH_REVISION_COMMAND_KINDS/GRAPH_REVISION_TRANSITIONS retain their existing signatures and observable values.
Stable errors, check precedence, compound version accounting, zero-state-change rejection, events, and deep-frozen results are unchanged.
Both production modules are <=250 physical lines and each has one named responsibility.
Existing graph hostile, lifecycle, concurrency, and invariant tests pass unchanged and the focused gate exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

implementationPlan.description: Characterize the refactor boundary without editing or running a gate: confirm the current 259-line reducer and clean owned paths; inventory the eight contiguous private helpers and every call site; grep the repository to prove no external importer depends on those helpers; record the public reducer exports and preserve the header's three-reducer atomic-composition contract. Treat the unchanged graph reducer and invariant suites as held-out characterization.

Extract the existing helper block by verbatim move into new `graph-revision-results.ts`. Export exactly the eight package-internal helpers needed by the reducer, preserve their comments, signatures, RuntimeError construction/details/source states, deep-freeze calls, event handling, and content-identity exclusion in `clonedState`; add only minimal value/type imports from `@moe/contracts`, `graph-revision-contract.js`, and `planning-snapshot.js`. Update `graph-revision-reducer.ts` to import those helpers with a NodeNext `.js` specifier and remove only now-unused imports. Keep the reducer header, frozen command/transition exports, per-command handlers, check/call order, and `reduceGraphRevision` signature/value surface byte-semantically unchanged; do not re-export the helpers or edit root index/tests. Both modules must be <=250 physical lines.

Run the single exact regression gate once after the extraction: `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test`. Require exit 0 and retain the fresh command, exit code, and output tail as `moe.complete_task` evidence. Any failure is extraction drift in the two owned production paths; do not edit or weaken held-out tests.

Perform the one final adversarial review. Compare each moved helper body/comment with the committed pre-split reducer and prove the original block is represented exactly once; inspect for reordered reducer checks/calls, changed stable codes/details/source states, missing deep freezes, changed event/version order, content-hash patchability, accidental root/reducer helper exports, cycles, or lost composition commentary. Use an in-memory cross-platform Node line counter to prove both owned files are <=250 for LF/CRLF/CR, confirm non-owned contracts/index/tests are untouched, and run `git diff --check`. If review requires any edit, rerun the exact gate before completion. Then inspect shared `git status --porcelain`, stage/commit only `packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.ts` and `packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts` by explicit pathspec (never broad add or bare commit), and verify `git show --stat` lists exactly those two paths.

reopenReason: Human explicitly requested PLAN; promoting the next ordered, file-disjoint planning decomposition child.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Keep the task's pre-named seam: move the contiguous result/error/state-clone helper block (`rejected`, `unknownFailure`, `illegal`, `rebound`, `supersededAuthority`, `versionConflict`, `accepted`, `clonedState`) into graph-revision-results.ts. This mirrors the sibling planning-results.ts responsibility and alone reduces the reducer below 250. Rejected splitting command handlers or transition tables because those are coherent reducer orchestration and would increase churn. Rejected retyping or redesigning helpers; move bodies/comments verbatim. Rejected baseline/full-repo/double gate runs from the prior plan because current moe-planning requires one concentrated exact gate at task end.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: graph-revision-reducer.ts is 259 physical lines. The cohesive helper block is lines 64-121; no external file imports these private helpers. The public package/root surface is only GRAPH_REVISION_COMMAND_KINDS, GRAPH_REVISION_TRANSITIONS, and reduceGraphRevision, so the new helper module stays package-internal and is not re-exported by root or reducer. The lines 1-17 composition-contract header is authoritative reviewer context and stays on the reducer. Core uses NodeNext `.js` specifiers without source `.js` shims. Existing graph-revision-reducer.test.ts and planning-invariants.test.ts are held-out characterization and must remain byte-unchanged.
planningNotes.risks: Any retyped helper can alter stable code/source/detail construction, rejection precedence, zero-state-change semantics, compound version accounting, or deep freezing. Preserve every helper body/comment and the reducer's call order exactly. Do not export helpers through the package root, change reducer constants/signatures, drop the three-reducer composition comment, or touch tests. Count LF/CRLF/CR portably rather than using Unix-only wc. Shared-tree staging must name only the two owned paths.
